title: The BIND 9.x server implementation must have fetches-per-server enabled.
fixtext:
Modify the BIND configuration file (/etc/named.conf ).

Add the fetches-per-server option to the "options" section of the configuration file.

fetches-per-server <integer> drop; 
 
After making changes, reload or restart BIND to apply the new settings.
VulnDiscussion: The fetches-per-server option in BIND 9.x configures a limit on the number of outstanding requests (fetches) allowed for a single DNS server. This rate-limiting mechanism helps protect the BIND 9.x server from being overwhelmed by excessive requests to a specific server, particularly when that server is slow or unresponsive.
